Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning state agencies' duty to control the spread of noxious weeds.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to noxious weeds; and amending RCW 17.10.145.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 17.10.145 and 1997 c 353 s 18 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: All state agencies shall control noxious weeds on lands they own,lease, or otherwise control through integrated pest managementpractices, and shall give first priority to the control of class A andB designate noxious weeds occurring within five hundred feet ofadjacent private property. Agencies shall develop plans in cooperationwith county noxious weed control boards to control noxious weeds inaccordance with standards in this chapter. All state agencies' landsmust comply with this chapter, regardless of noxious weed controlefforts on adjacent lands.
